about: The Data Wire: one line per change, newest first, written every 30 minutes by tools/pulse.mjs from the issuers' own contracts and files and from SEC EDGAR's filing lists. flow: tokens created and destroyed by the issuer contract since the previous pulse (at least 1,000,000 tokens either way); supply: a contract total that moved by at least that much; issuer-file: a new update time on an issuer's own file; filing: a new filing of a followed form. Market context, never filed: figures filed on the platform go through the founder's approval. state holds the starting points of the next pulse.
